Report Description
***THIS IS AN UPDATE TO A PREVIOUS NRC REPORT*** RP STATED THAT A PASSENGER VEHICLE STRUCK A 500 LB. 30" STEEL DISTRIBUTION PIPELINE. RP STATED THAT THERE WERE TWO (2) REPORTED INJURIES AND BOTH INDIVIDUALS WERE TRANSPORTED TO A HOSPITAL. RP STATED THAT IT IS BELIEVED THAT THE TWO REPORTED INJURED ARE CITIZENS. THE FIRE DEPARTMENT HAS EVACUATED THE ALLEN ROAD/ ELIZABETH CROSS (EVERYONE NORTH) IN THE MELVINDALE AREA. ***NRC #1152246*** THE RP IS REPORTING A RELEASE OF NATURAL GAS DUE TO UNKNOWN CAUSES. RP STATED THAT A GAS LINE IS EXPOSED, HOWEVER CREWS ARE UNABLE TO GET CLOSE ENOUGH TO DETERMINE THE CAUSE. RP STATED THERE IS WAS AN IGNITION AND THE FLAMES ARE VISIBLE FOR MILES.
